name: Littelfuse, Inc.
business: Circuit protection (fuses, TVS), power semiconductors and sensors for industrial, data-center, automotive and electronics markets.

pros: Growth re-accelerating (+20% sales) with data-center tailwind
High-voltage data-center design wins scaling from 2027

metrics.summary: Littelfuse, Inc. designs, manufactures, and sells electronic components, modules, and subassemblies. It operates through three segments: Electronics, Transportation, and Industrial. Its Electronics segment offers fuses and fuse accessories, coefficient resettable fuses, switches and interconnect solutions, polymer electrostatic discharge suppressors, varistors, reed switch based magnetic sensing,
